---
name: MediaWiki demo (computed by GitHub's renderer)
about: Type some text; GitHub's MediaWiki renderer computes a tiny neural net on it
title: "mediawiki: "
---

Put some text in the **title** after `mediawiki:` (letters, spaces and basic punctuation), then Submit. An Action writes your text into a MediaWiki page and replies with a link. Every number on that page is evaluated by GitHub's own renderer; the Action does no arithmetic. Leave this body as is.
